resources.string: This app lets axross, the file manager on your computer, read your SMS, MMS and contacts and send SMS - over USB, through ADB, when you connect the phone and allow USB debugging.\n\nOnly a computer connected by ADB can talk to it; other apps on this phone cannot. It has no internet access. Every message it sends is one you wrote and sent in axross.
This app keeps no data of its own, and nothing is logged of your messages, numbers or contacts. Source and licence: github.com/c0decave/axross-android-companion (Apache-2.0).
This app is the default SMS app (make your own messaging app the default again when a restore is done).
Another app is the default SMS app (normal). Deleting, marking read and restoring need this app to be the default for a while.
Not listening (axross starts it when it connects).

resources.string: Messages already on the phone are not touched; ones that are there already are skipped.

Android lets only the default SMS app write messages: after \"Restore\" Android asks you to make axross companion the default SMS app. When the restore is done, make your own messaging app the default again (a notification reminds you). While the companion is the default, new SMS are stored, but MMS are not received.
There is no restore waiting for an answer (it may have expired or been answered).
axross companion does not write messages for other apps. Write in axross on your computer, or make your own messaging app the default SMS app again.
